title: rhodiola yunnanensis
intro: Rhodiola yunnanensis, commonly known as Yunnan Rhodiola, is a plant species in the Crassulaceae family that grows in the mountainous regions of Yunnan, China. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving mental performance, and enhancing physical endurance. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola yunnanensis are attributed to its adaptogenic properties, which help to balance the body's physiological response to stress. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola yunnanensis include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, such as rossolavin A, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
